framework.name: Pilot ISMS & Security Assurance Baseline

license_metadata.source_name: GRC Platform Project original pilot baseline
license_metadata.provenance: Authored specifically for the GRC Platform pilot; no standards text was copied into this pack.
license_metadata.notice: Original implementation baseline. It does not reproduce ISO, COBIT or AFTA copyrighted requirement text. Crosswalks to licensed/customer-provided frameworks are added separately and require human approval.

framework.description: Original pilot baseline for testing governance, asset, identity, backup, logging, vulnerability, incident and assurance workflows.

metadata.crosswalk_policy: Human approval is required before a common-control or requirement mapping is treated as approved.

requirements.title: Security responsibilities have accountable owners
requirements.body: Assign accountable owners for security governance and review responsibilities after material organizational changes.
requirements.title_fa: مسئولیت‌های امنیتی دارای مالک پاسخگو باشند

requirements.title: Material information and technology assets are inventoried
requirements.body: Maintain ownership and criticality information for material assets.
requirements.title_fa: دارایی‌های مهم اطلاعاتی و فناوری شناسایی و مالک‌گذاری شوند

requirements.title: Privileged access uses strong multi-factor authentication
requirements.body: Require multi-factor authentication for privileged administrative access unless an approved exception exists.
requirements.title_fa: دسترسی‌های ممتاز از احراز هویت چندمرحله‌ای قوی استفاده کنند

requirements.title: Critical backups are monitored and recoverability is evidenced
requirements.body: Monitor critical backup jobs and retain evidence that recovery points are available.
requirements.title_fa: پشتیبان‌گیری‌های حیاتی پایش و قابلیت بازیابی آنها مستند شود

requirements.title: Security-relevant events are logged and reviewed
requirements.body: Collect and review security-relevant logs according to approved retention and monitoring rules.
requirements.title_fa: رویدادهای امنیتی ثبت و بازبینی شوند

requirements.title: Material vulnerabilities are identified and remediated by risk
requirements.body: Run approved vulnerability assessments and track material findings to remediation or formally accepted risk.
requirements.title_fa: آسیب‌پذیری‌های مهم بر اساس ریسک شناسایی و اصلاح شوند

requirements.title: Security incidents have defined response ownership and escalation
requirements.body: Define accountable incident response ownership, escalation paths and evidence retention.
requirements.title_fa: برای رخدادهای امنیتی مالک پاسخگویی و مسیر تشدید مشخص باشد

requirements.title: Control implementation claims are supported by current evidence
requirements.body: Maintain attributable, current evidence for material control implementation claims.
requirements.title_fa: ادعاهای پیاده‌سازی کنترل با شواهد جاری پشتیبانی شوند
